name: Number–Letter Churn
goal: Watch the numbers and letters. Then tap the numbers from smallest to largest, then the letters in A-B-C order.
tip: While you watch, start sorting: put each number in its place in your mind, and each letter in its place.
voice: Numbers and letters will appear one at a time, mixed up.
Then, tap the numbers first, from the smallest to the largest.
After the numbers, tap the letters in alphabet order.
watch: Watch and start sorting in your mind
guide: Numbers small to big, then letters A to Z
